summary: Backend-only external-ingress testing completed. All 21 requested happy-path/auth/CRUD/integration checks passed, including Resend rejection tolerance, OTP attempt persistence and verification, Redis cart CRUD, order/payment flow, recommendations/cache refresh, admin CRUD, and role enforcement. Six defensive validation checks failed (21/27 overall passed).

critical.issue: Accepts qty=0 and qty=-1, persists zero/negative-value orders, and returns 200; reproduced subtotal/total=-189.00 for qty=-1.
Accepts and publishes products with negative prices (price=-10 returned 200).
Does not enforce size stock; accepted qty=9 when M stock was 8, allowing overselling.
Accepts invalid coupon rules: count expiry with max_uses=null (effectively never expires) and percent discount=150.

minor.issue: Password operations work, but backend logs repeatedly show passlib/bcrypt compatibility warning: bcrypt has no attribute __about__.

action_items: Constrain OrderItemIn.qty to >0 and revalidate in order placement before any DB write; also validate requested size and available stock.
Add positive/nonnegative Pydantic constraints for product price and stock values.
Add conditional coupon validation: count requires max_uses>0, time requires a future valid_until, percent must be within 0..100, and monetary values must be nonnegative.
Resolve the installed passlib/bcrypt API mismatch to remove runtime warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: schemas.py declares order qty, product price/stock, and coupon values as unconstrained primitives; admin.py only validates enum strings, causing all reproduced invalid-state defects.
orders.py calculates totals directly from unvalidated qty and commits them, so negative quantities become durable negative orders.
cart.py checks only qty>0 and product existence, but never validates size, per-size stock, or accumulated quantity against stock.
redis_client.py contains a hardcoded localhost fallback instead of failing fast when REDIS_URL is missing.
Several async routes perform synchronous SQLAlchemy/Redis operations on the event loop; use sync route functions or offload/migrate blocking I/O to avoid concurrency stalls.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ users, orders, product, and coupons; all were cleaned directly after testing. Redis carts were cleared and FIRST10 used_count was restored to 0. Final checks: 8 active products, 0 TEST users/products/coupons.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -n 0 -v --tb=short --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Serial mode avoids the exact-8 catalog assertion racing with the admin product creation test. Resend rejected example.com recipients and the unverified knitcult.com sender as expected; register/order endpoints still returned 200 and completed. External URL came from frontend/.env.
rca_of_the_issue: Missing schema and route-level commerce constraints are the common root cause. OrderItemIn.qty is a plain int; ProductAdminIn.price and stock values are unconstrained; CouponAdminIn has no bounds or cross-field validation; cart logic does not compare requested quantity to product.stock. Reproduction responses and failures are captured in pytest_results.xml.
